_comment: Trimmed, real-shape sample of GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/endpoints/zdr, captured 2026-09-26. Note the id field here is `model_id`, NOT `id` as on /api/v1/models — the two endpoints do not share a key name. openrouter/auto has zero entries in the real response (it is a router, not a concrete model with its own ZDR endpoint) and z-ai/glm-5.3-prime also has zero real entries as of capture, which is what lets upstreamCore.test.mjs exercise a genuine 'no ZDR coverage' finding against real data. The typesafe/jev-1.13 row (the quality check's pinned model) is copied from the same live response, trimmed to the fields kept here; it is that model's only endpoint (GET /api/v1/models/typesafe/jev-1.13/endpoints, same day), and the model has no entry in /api/v1/models at all.
